purpose: What has and has not been checked for each model used on a Patient Lab result page, in the four validation layers of docs/PATIENT_LAB_2_0.md. Shown in every run record so a result is read together with the evidence behind its model.

layers.software_verification: The code computes the intended equations.
layers.transcription_verification: The parameters and equations match the source.
layers.reproduction: The model reproduces results from the data it was fitted to.
layers.external_consistency: Agreement with data not used to fit the model.

never_established: Clinical prediction validity. Passing every layer supports research use only; clinical_prediction_validated stays false.

lenalidomide_hughes_2019.name: Lenalidomide population PK (Hughes et al. 2019)
lenalidomide_hughes_2019.citation: Hughes et al. Br J Clin Pharmacol. 2019;85:924-934

software_verification.summary: Solver checked against an independent analytic reference on synthetic cases.

transcription_verification.summary: Main-text parameter table reviewed; the supplementary control stream was not retrieved.

reproduction.summary: No reproduction of the source's own published results has been run on this platform.

external_consistency.summary: Aggregate check of group-mean exposure relative to normal renal function, study CC-5013-PK-001 (EMA assessment): mild consistent; moderate and severe under-predicted.

lenalidomide_kim_2026.name: Lenalidomide population PK in renal impairment (Kim et al. 2026)
lenalidomide_kim_2026.citation: Kim H, Park SS, Choi S, et al. Drug Des Devel Ther. 2026;20:605741

software_verification.summary: Exact two-compartment solution checked against numerical integration in the test suite.

transcription_verification.summary: Tables and printed equations transcribed; the printed CL/F equation form conflicts with the paper's own results, and a multiplicative reading is used until the authors confirm.

reproduction.summary: Typical total CL/F at each group's median covariates lies within one SD of the authors' Table 2 group means. Same patients as the fit, so this confirms transcription, not predictive performance.

external_consistency.summary: Aggregate check of group-mean exposure relative to normal renal function, study CC-5013-PK-001 (EMA assessment): mild and moderate consistent; severe under-predicted in the primary scenario (consistent in some alternative scenarios).

bortezomib_platelets_lignet_2022.name: Bortezomib thrombocytopenia model (Lignet et al. 2022)
bortezomib_platelets_lignet_2022.citation: Lignet F, et al. CPT Pharmacometrics Syst Pharmacol. 2022;11(5):594-603

software_verification.summary: Exact three-compartment PK solution checked against numerical integration; platelet integration repeated at half step size.

transcription_verification.summary: AI-assisted transcription from the article and supplement; independent review pending. Units of the drug-effect term and its bound were not stated and were settled by the reproduction check.

reproduction.summary: Locked check against the fitting data (Lonial 2005): both variants consistent with the observed cycle 1 day 11 fall only with concentrations in ng/mL and the effect term as printed.

external_consistency.summary: No data outside the fitting study have been compared.
